select
from survey_case_direction
where 1 = 1 and delete_flag = 0
order by sort desc, survey_investigator_case_id asc,id asc
limit #{pageIndex}, #{pageSize}

select count(1) from survey_case_direction
where 1 = 1 and delete_flag = 0

select i.real_name as surveyUserName, i.user_id as surveyUserId, i.tel as tel, i.org_name as surveyOrgName, i.org_id as surveyOrgId, IFNULL(sum(sic.score),0) as scores from survey_investigator i left join survey_investigator_case sic on sic.survey_user_id = i.user_id and sic.delete_flag =0 left join survey_risk_case_info b on sic.survey_info_id = b.id and b.delete_flag =0 where 1 = 1 and i.delete_flag = 0
and i.bus_type in (${busType})
GROUP BY i.user_id order by i.org_id,scores desc
limit #{pageIndex}, #{pageSize}

select i.real_name as surveyUserName, b.survey_no as surveyNo,b.entrust_org_name as entrustOrgName, IFNULL(sic.score,0) as score, rc.survey_person as surveyPerson from survey_investigator_case sic left join survey_risk_case_info b on sic.survey_info_id = b.id left join survey_risk_case rc on b.survey_id = rc.id left join survey_investigator i on sic.survey_user_id = i.user_id where 1 = 1 and sic.delete_flag = 0 and b.delete_flag = 0 and sic.survey_user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select d.direction_name as directionName,d.entrust_money as entrustMoney,d.survey_money as surveyMoney,d.survey_info_id as surveyInfoId from survey_case_direction d left join survey_risk_case_info s on d.survey_info_id = s.id where d.delete_flag = 0 and s.delete_flag = 0 and s.entrust_report_end_date is not null
and s.entrust_org_id = #{entrustOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND date_format(s.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(s.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

select
from survey_case_direction d left join survey_investigator_case s on d.survey_investigator_case_id = s.id LEFT JOIN survey_risk_case_info a ON s.survey_info_id = a.id left join survey_consignor n on a.entrust_org_id = n.id where d.delete_flag = 0 and s.delete_flag = 0 and n.org_attr = 1 and d.survey_org_id in (select id from survey_franchisee where id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT} or parent_id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
and a.entrust_report_start_date is not null
AND date_format(a.entrust_report_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(a.entrust_report_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
and a.entrust_report_end_date is not null
AND date_format(a.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(a.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
